rule.rule: declared before any after_confirm patch was fetched: a candidate persists if the same change features recomputed on (before_primary, after_confirm) still give log-odds > 0 at the candidate pixel and the main contrast feature keeps its sign with >= min_retained_contrast of its primary magnitude; a confirm pair with cloud/snow/nodata at the candidate (valid fractions below the minima) is not assessable. Statuses: LIKELY only if persists AND the visual review notes a slide-like scar; REJECTED only with a named non-slide cause (land use, water) or a transient artefact that did not persist; otherwise UNVERIFIED.
rule.known_positives: all 423 V0.4 positives (data/v04 dataset, read only); the candidate inventory distance column used only the 129 satellite positives
rule.dedup_note: overlapping 2.56 km patches of neighbouring events detect the same location several times; detections within dedup_m are one physical candidate (highest score kept, others listed as aliases)
rule.confirm_screened_at_candidate: satellite-0.3: the (before_primary, after_confirm) pair is recomputed with the same buffered mask; a candidate is assessable only if its own core/ring keep the validation minima after buffering, and the distance from the candidate pixel to the nearest cloud-like pixel in after_confirm is recorded
